SANKET LAVATE LEAD BUSINESS ANALYST / PRODUCT OWNER

PROFILE SUMMARY

Lead Business Analyst / Product Owner with 9+ years of experience across Payments, BFSI, Finance, Healthcare, and E-commerce domains, specializing in Core Banking, RTGS, NEFT, Cross-Border Payments, SWIFT MT/MX, ISO 20022, CBPR+, SEPA, and MT to MX migration. Experienced in requirements gathering, stakeholder management, Agile delivery, functional & solution consulting, operations and project coordination, UAT, and end-to-end payment lifecycle. Proficient in SQL, Tableau, Power BI, and AI tools for data analysis, documentation, and process optimization.

WORK EXPERIENCE

REI Systems Lead Business Analyst / Product Owner

OCT2022 - PRESENT

Projects

>Grant & Cross-Border Payment Tracking Portal

Objective: Developed a portal for operations teams and corporate customers to track

SWIFT cross-border payments from initiation to settlement, including payment

status, exception handling, SWIFT reference search, and reconciliation.

>SWIFT MT to ISO 20022 (CBPR+) Migration

Objective: To enable the bank to transition from SWIFT MT messages to ISO 20022

(MX) under the CBPR+ program for cross-border payments, ensuring regulatory

compliance, standardized messaging, enhanced data quality, and uninterrupted payment processing.

Roles and Responsibilities:

Acted as the primary liaison between business stakeholders, product owners, and

technical teams to gather, analyze, and document business and functional requirements.

Conducted stakeholder workshops with business users, payment operations, and issuing/correspondent banks to understand payment processing requirements

and regulatory changes.

Prepared BRDs, FRDs, user stories, process flows, and acceptance criteria for

payment system enhancements.

Defined and validated SWIFT MT to ISO 20022 (MX) message mapping (e.g.,

MT103 → pacs.008, MT202 → pacs.009) in accordance with CBPR+ guidelines. Analyzed bank implementation guidelines and payment specifications to identify

functional gaps, perform impact analysis, and provide root cause analysis (RCA)

for production issues.

Collaborated with development teams to define business rules, payment validations, and message transformation logic for payment file conversion and

optimization.

Worked with payment messaging standards including SWIFT

MT1xx/MT2xx/MT9xx, ISO 20022 (pacs, pain), SEPA, and CBPR+. Coordinated API and integration discussions with Core Banking, Payment Hub, and external banking systems to ensure seamless end-to-end payment .

TOOLS

Power BI

Tableau

SQL

MS – Excel, Power Point,

Axure RP

AI Tools - Chat GPT, Notion

AI, Productboard, Aha!, Figma

AI, Claude AI

LANGUAGES

English (Fluent)

Hindi (Fluent)

Marathi (Fluent)

Sonova

FEB 2019 - OCT2022

Business Analyst

interactions, rejections, and exception handling

Created and managed user stories, product backlog, and priorities using Jira.

Collaborated with technical teams to clarify business requirements and ensure

accurate implementation.

Prepared and reviewed key documentation including BRD, FRD, Use Cases, and

Requirement Traceability Matrix (RTM).

Supported test planning, test case reviews, client demonstrations, and UAT

Gathered and analyzed business requirements for healthcare applications,

collaborating with clinical, business, and technical stakeholders to deliver scalable

and compliant solutions across the healthcare ecosystem.

Facilitated stakeholder workshops, requirement gathering sessions, and solution

design discussions with business and technical teams.

Paytm Project Lead / Business Analyst

SEP 2016 - FEB 2019

Gathered, analyzed, and documented business and functional requirements for

payment processing, e-commerce, and vendor registration solutions, collaborating

with business stakeholders until sign-off.

Analyzed end-to-end payment lifecycle including payment initiation, validation,

authorization, clearing, settlement, reconciliation, and exception handling. Worked on Core Banking payment processes, supporting RTGS, NEFT, SWIFT

MT/MX, ISO 20022.

Gathered requirements for an E-commerce Portal, including customer onboarding,

product catalog, shopping cart, payment gateway integration, order management,

and transaction tracking.

Worked on a Vendor Registration Portal, defining workflows for supplier

onboarding, KYC/document verification, approval processes, vendor profile

management, and payment information maintenance.

Coordinated SIT/UAT, defect management, and production validation to ensure

successful delivery of payment and digital commerce solutions.

EDUCATION

MBA(Marketing) from Indira Institute of Management (AICTE), Pune 2014. B. Pharmacy from ABCP Sangli, KOLHAPUR University in 2012 HSC (Science)-Ganpatrao Arwade College of Arts & Science SSC-City High School, Sangli

PERSONAL DETAILS

Date of Birth - 17th May 1990 Marital Status - Married Nationality - Indian Interest - Travelling, Learning new culture.
